note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped. npm run qa:cover-recipes re-renders it through motion.mjs cover and fails when median d or the moving share leaves +-15 % of this row, seamLocal leaves TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured on headless Chrome's software rung (SwiftShader) and libwebp 1.6.0.
base: test/fixtures/cover-recipes/painted-light-base.png in the LitGrok repository, the five-bay LitFamily painting (1536 x 1024); another painting needs its own PAINTING block

treatment.request: Make the LitFamily README motion cover from the painted robot line-up.
treatment.idea: A window of work light walks the sleeping bays while the LitGrok robot's lenses wake in turn and a comet laps its frame.
treatment.recipeReason: The painting already carries the brand, so the loop relights it instead of drawing over it.

layers.slow: A comet laps the LitGrok frame and motes rise one screen per loop.
layers.mid: A sharp-edged light window walks the four other bays once per loop, with scan bands at two passes.
layers.beat: The three lenses light top to bottom twice per loop, one glint crosses the title, and the LIT. accent pulses at t = 0 and 0.5.

system.rule: One light window and one scan band rule.
system.copies: Five bays, three lenses and forty-eight motes.
system.offset: Each bay's phase comes from its x position; each lens from its height.

treatment.ambition: Light reads as moving edges that survive the encoder, and the seam disappears under the accent pulse.

feather-150.defect: Light drawn as a soft 150 px wash instead of a travelling 24 px edge. At this recipe's encode the encoder keeps the soft edge, so no motion gate sees it and only the 2 MiB size TARGET trips; the wash itself is caught by look review.
